subject: Demo recap & proposed evaluation playbook — KilnWorks trial (next steps)
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@kilnworks.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@kilnworks.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap & proposed evaluation playbook — KilnWorks trial (next steps)

Hi Aisha / Tom,

Thanks again for your time this morning — great conversation.  As promised, I wanted to capture a concise evaluation playbook so we can align on success criteria, timeline, and owners before we schedule the technical kickoff. I attached a one-page playbook and the trial checklist for quick reference.

High-level recap (from our demo)
- Goal: Validate Redwood Inference for customer-facing summarization & search augmentation in the Kiln Q&A product.
- Primary constraints: sub-300ms P50 inference for single-turn queries; throughput target ~75 qps for peak periods; strict PII handling & retention controls.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm / adjust):
1) Latency: P50 < 300ms and P95 < 800ms on US-West instance with sample prompt set.
2) Quality: >= 85% pass rate on 100-priority prompt set (measured via rubric in the playbook).
3) Cost envelope: unit inference cost <= $0.12 per 1k tokens for production-ish workload.
4) Reliability: no more than 0.1% error rate across 72-hour soak test.

Evaluation plan & timeline (4 weeks suggested)
- Week 0 (this week): sign trial terms, confirm data access and environment (owner: Procurement / Lauren).
- Week 1: staging instance + sample data load; smoke tests (owner: Ben).
- Week 2: run full prompt suite, collect metrics and logs (owner: KilnWorks + Ben).
- Week 3: perform soak/load test, address tuning (owners: Ben & KilnWorks eng).
- Week 4: capture final report & decision checklist (owners: Lauren / Aisha).

Owners & contact points
- Commercial lead: Lauren Bishop (Redwood) — program/acceptance criteria.
- Technical lead: Ben Carter (Redwood) — staging, integration, tuning.
- KilnWorks lead: Aisha Khan — sample data & prompt set; procurement.

Next asks for you
- Confirm the success criteria above or suggest edits by EOD Wed.
- Confirm who from your side will own data delivery and procurement questions.
- Pick two 30-minute slots for the technical kickoff next week (Ben will lead).

Attachments: kilnworks-eval-playbook-v1.pdf, redwood-trial-checklist.xlsx

If this looks good I’ll send the trial terms (DocuSign) and lock a kickoff.

Best,
Lauren
Lauren Bishop

Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed evaluation playbook — KilnWorks trial (next steps)

Thanks Lauren — appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

- Data residency: we need the trial instance to be hosted in US-West (Oregon) and confirm that logs with PII are masked/obfuscated by default. Can you confirm retention and masking behavior?
- Procurement: we’ll need a short RFI for security/compliance (I attached the template we typically use). Can Redwood fill this out?
- Success criteria: the latency targets look reasonable; I want to add a human-review sampling step if quality is borderline (we’ll provide reviewers).

Proposed kickoff windows next week: Wed 10am–12pm PT or Thu 2pm–4pm PT. Either works for Tom and me.

Attaching: KilnWorks-POC-RFI.docx

Hi Aisha — thanks, and great questions. Short answers below and next steps: 

- Residency & retention: Confirmed — trial will run in US-West (Oregon). By default we enable token-level masking for user-supplied documents and rotate logs after 30 days for trial instances; we can adjust retention for enterprise accounts if needed. I’ll include the specific privacy artifacts in the RFI response.
- RFI: happy to fill KilnWorks-POC-RFI.docx. I’ll coordinate with our security lead and return a completed copy by EOD Thu.
- Human-review step: noted — we’ll include a short sampling pipeline in week 2 so your reviewers can tag examples; we’ll capture reviewer feedback as part of the quality metric.

DocuSign: I’m going to send our short trial MSA via DocuSign once you confirm the kickoff slot. Link will include the trial terms (no production data access, limited retention, liability caps for evaluation).

Proposed kickoff: Wed 23 Jun, 10:30–11:00 PT (30 min). If that doesn’t work I can shift to Thu 24 Jun, 14:30–15:00 PT. Please confirm which you prefer.

I’ll also loop Ben for technical coordination (SSO, data ingress, test harness).

Thanks — Lauren

Aisha / Lauren — I’ll be your technical lead for the trial. Quick notes and triple-check items before kickoff: 

1) Staging endpoint: https://staging-us-west.redwood-inference.com/kl-678 (we’ll provision creds after DocuSign).
2) Data schema: please share a small sample (10–20 rows) of the customer prompts + expected outputs; we’ll run the smoke tests against that set.
3) Auth: we support SSO (SAML) and API-key access for the trial. Let me know which you prefer; SSO takes an extra 1–2 business days to set up.
4) Integration checklist (attached) — includes the prompt harness, expected metrics export format, and the soak test plan.

I can take the Wed 23 Jun 10:30–11:00 PT kickoff. During that call we’ll aim to: provision the instance, validate schema mapping, and schedule the week-2 measurement run.
